messages:
Tara H.: Quick thread for the upcoming docs publish. Top items: tidy changelog bullets, add a tiny migration snippet for embeddings (stream -> poll), fix a couple of redirect anchors, and ensure SDK snippet parity across py/js. PRs: #6012 (changelog), #6020 (snippets), #6025 (redirects).
Ben C.: I can do the snippet parity sweep. Plan: replace `client.generate()` -> `client.responses.create()` in py/js, and add one-line migration hints above each sample.
Ivy Z.: I'll tighten the changelog language. Keep each change to one short sentence and add a single-line known-issue about cache warm-up latency.
Tara H.: For migration snippet please include both JS and Python minimal examples. One-line JS hint: `const job = await client.embeddings.create({input: batch}); // poll job.status`
Ben C.: Pushed commit to #6020: updated py/js samples and added a tiny note about rate limiting when switching from streaming to batch. CI pending.
ci-bot: CI: #6020 checks started.
docs-bot: Reminder: docs publish window is tomorrow 09:00 PT. Any changelog merges must be in by 07:30 PT.
Ivy Z.: Draft bullets for #6012: "Adaptive routing defaults updated; canary traffic may hit fallbacks during cache warm-up." and "Embedding streaming deprecated; use batch embeddings + polling (see migration guide)." Known issue: "Cache warm-up may cause short latency spikes."
Ben C.: #6020 CI green; merging now. Also fixed a stray absolute http link in the python sample.
ci-bot: CI: #6020 merged. #6025 redirects MR shows one anchor mismatch on /guides/auth.
Ben C.: Patched anchor in #6025. Re-running link-check.
ci-bot: #6025 link-check passed.
Tara H.: Final checklist: 1) merge #6012 (Ivy) 2) #6020 merged (Ben) 3) #6025 merged (Ben) 4) post-merge link-check run. I will queue the changelog after CI green.
Ivy Z.: #6012 merged. Changelog ready.
docs-bot: Changelog queued for publish. Post-merge link-check clean. If anything needs a rollback after publish, post "docs-rollback" here and tag @Tara H.
Tara H.: Thanks all 680. Quick retro: next round let's add a snippet-parity checklist to the PR template so small mismatches don't slip through.
